art_direction: 奶油色宽带绕成开放回环，湖蓝底与一枚小绿块点缀内侧。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Draw one wide cream-colored ribbon as an open loop on a lagoon-blue field. It should bend around an irregular central opening and stop before closing, leaving a clear gap at the lower right. Add one small moss-green rounded shape tucked just inside the upper bend. Keep the ribbon flat and continuous, with no overlapping depth or cast shadow. Vary its width slightly through the turn. The two shapes should create a quiet visual rhythm, with plenty of uninterrupted background around them. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
